Callout.Name: Industrial Accident
Callout.Message: Worker injured by machinery at a depot.

Script.Line: The guard came off the machine. It should never have been off.
I have been on that line eleven years. Nothing has ever done that.
The foreman is not here. Nobody knows where the foreman is.

Callout.Patient: I cannot see how bad it is. Tell me how bad it is.

Lines.Approach: Their hand was in it when it went. The machinery is stopped and so is the bleeding, for now.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
